# openwebui_ollama_connection_verify (Data Source)

Verifies that an Ollama backend is reachable from Open WebUI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Open WebUI makes the request, so the backend has to be reachable from the
# Open WebUI server, not from the machine running Terraform. The read fails if
# it is not.
data "openwebui_ollama_connection_verify" "local" {
  url = "http://ollama.internal:11434"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) Base URL of the Ollama backend, e.g. `http://localhost:11434`.

### Optional

- `key` (String, Sensitive) Optional API key for authenticated Ollama instances. Sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `verified` (Boolean) Always `true`. The read fails with an error when Open WebUI cannot reach the backend, so this attribute never reads `false`.
